steps.content:
7:00 p.m., January 20, N.F. 113
My Best Cool Car temporary filming spot

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Ta ta ta tum! Good evening, everyone! It's been 24 hours since we last met! How much do y'all miss me?

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: I really... miss you guys!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: After a hard day's work, OwO the Lion Dancing Queen is bringing over all the new recruits as promised!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: The official shoot is about to start. We're now gonna have an important pre-shoot meeting. Come on, let's get pumped!

steps.speaker: Everyone
steps.content: Applause!
You smile dryly and clap your hands. Clap... clap... clap... Seeing all the faces on camera, grumbles of discontent start whirling in your head like a tornado.

How did this little girl manage to find so many people after just waltzing around for two days? What kind of devilry is this? This was supposed to be an easy, one-on-one mission. How come it suddenly feels like a lion's den?

Also, how come all three are Sinners? Add to that Apostle... is OwO really just an innocent little girl? Does she really have no powers to attract Mania? Forget about making movies. She should work for the MBCC City Arrest Team!
Plus... can this motley crew really be counted on to make a movie?

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: We officially have a crew now. The journey to the DisCars is about to begin. It's time to think about some more serious issues! Such as...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: How do we stand out from the crowd and make a name for ourselves? What other preparations shall we make?
Guess we can only rely on dreaming. Get your pillows ready.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: At the end of the day, it's the almighty DisCars we're talking about. Even though I'm putting my winning name in the lot, there'll be a lot of little monkeys elbowing each other to try their luck. So I've been thinking long and hard about it.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: So far, I've created 3 masterpieces, dabbled in different genres, and reached the height of cinematic excellence.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: But because of this, I realized I'm still missing something. Something really important...
So there's something that even the world's most splendiferous louder-than-thunder faster-than-lightning Lion Dancing Queen's forgot-how-many-generations of heirs OwO doesn't have.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Yeah... I want people's eyes to pop, hearts to thump, and bodies to tremble all over... Something that catches everyone's...

steps.speaker: Love
steps.content: Catches everyone's eyes? Oh, I know how to do that! Pack the film with explosive scenes, then throw in a few of the hottest stars. That's how we do it at DeadLover Radio, but it works everywhere. The DisCars are no different.

steps.speaker: Love
steps.content: But right now, Love is the only celebrity we have onboard. We come off as a bit weak. It'd better if we had a star-studded cast and crew.

steps.speaker: Daisy
steps.content: Ignore that daydreamer. "Eye-catching" is a subjective term. To put it more scientifically, you want something that would do great at the box office?

steps.speaker: Daisy
steps.content: That seems to be a set criterion for the DisCars. Who can we get to distribute the film? Is there a publicity strategy? What about the cost?

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: I... I also heard that if you want to win a DisCar, you have to win the judges' approval. But the judges will write off all the works produced by people they don't know...

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: That is to say... um... we might need some... connections?
Well well well... Seems like the crew is a lot more thoughtful than OwO.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Mmm... what do you think, ${PlayerName}?

steps.speaker: Option
options: Suggest using realism as a theme

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The DisCars award cinematic art, and art needs depth. Judges will favor films that reflect DisCity's reality. In other words, we need to have some <color=#fb9259>realism</color>.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: For example, scavenging along the Rust, street snap in Eastside, vigilante justice in Syndicate, or observing animals in WhiteSands. Cost-effective and fun to watch. I also have a special friend who can help with the shooting.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Realism... realism...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: I know what's missing!
She suddenly jumps onto you.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: <color=#fb9259>Dazzling fantasy</color>!
...What's that? Where did you learn such a weird term?

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Since we're making a movie, we need imagination! Something different! Something so cool you can't even think of or encounter!

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: But... how can we film something that doesn't exist in real life?

steps.speaker: Love
steps.content: Oh! Ohohoh! What about special effects? CGI blockbusters are the biggest hits at the box office and nab prizes every year.

steps.speaker: Daisy
steps.content: I just want to remind everyone that special effects are charged by the second. We don't have that much money. Are you going to do crowdfunding? Or look for that goofy Gonzales boy?

She's right. The Bureau's funds have been completely drained after throwing a holiday party for the Sinners and paying the ensuing repairs. Right now, you can only ask the FAC for funds in the name of catching Apostles.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Hmm... special effects... I've seen a lot of that stuff at the Drifter Camp's underground theater.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Films like The Hero's Fight Against Draco, Tennis Wars: Screw Versus Nut, The Shapeshifter's 73 Faces...

steps.speaker: Daisy
steps.content: Uhhh... yeah, we definitely won't encounter those.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: Do those weird imaginary things... also count as dazzling fantasy?

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Of course not! Not even close. I forced myself to finish watching them even though I wanted to doze off. I felt nothing at all. If the DisCars were that level, then no one should watch it until I rescue it.

steps.speaker: Option
options: So what kind of dazzling fantasy does OwO want to bring?

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Hmm... dreamy feelings... romantic feelings... Something you've never thought about, but have been yearning for a long time...

The girl tries her best to string her words together, her pudgy little hands waving about in the air. It seems like she's trying to explain something, but at the same time trying to grasp something beyond explanation.
After trying for a while, she finally gives up.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Sigh... No, no, none of it feels right. It always feels a bit off.

steps.speaker: Option
options: Why don't we call it a day and sleep on it?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You must be tired from running around these past couple of days. Go to bed early tonight. When your little noggin is too tired, it won't find any inspiration.
The personnel involved have changed. You'd better go back and reassess the mission.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Ugh... okay. Seems like I really do need some rest after filming three masterpieces in a row.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: But don't worry! Just like I promised, My Best Cool Car Studios will definitely come up with the most amazing movie about courage, fun, and growth! And dazzling fantasy!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: I'll be sure to get new ideas after sleeping on it tonight! I won't keep you guys waiting for long!

steps.speaker: Option
options: Don't get too excited or you'll get insomnia.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: I won't! I'm not some kid on a field trip!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Good night, my fans! Send me any fun ideas you get!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: (Snores)...
At 3:23 a.m., you secretly start the vlog stream to contact the clerk from the Intelligence Department. Together, you observe the situation from a spot near the Rust.

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: Wow... you're right. She got a carload of Sinners.

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: This high-tech phone that Faye got is really cool. Its vlogging function lets us observe the situation in real time.

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: But I feel a bit guilty about using it...

steps.speaker: Option
options: This is all for the mission.
It's to protect the little girl.

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: Sigh... I know. The MBCC has bigger things to deal with. Leave everything to me!

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: Hehe, I knew you were the most caring and dashing person in the world! Chief, with you there, OwO will definitely be fine.

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: <size=32>S.T. has released a new clone in the last four hours. Powers that used to be vague have become clearer and more precise. According to our preliminary analysis, it's a quasi-concretization power, which can project the crowd's mental activities into reality.</size>

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: Most of the clones pop up in densely populated areas in Eastside, and their powers cause considerable chaos and destruction. The FAC must terminate them immediately. Stella is now the only one safe and stable enough to be observed.

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: I don't know if the main body will also affect it and cause it to change...

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: Ahhh!
The surveilled Apostle suddenly dashes in front of the camera. Its deep, round eyes staring straight at the image in the screen.

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: ...What... What's going on? Are we busted?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: There's just an ordinary cellphone at the scene. At most, it'll think the phone hasn't been turned off, and that there are some electric currents or something.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: We're hundreds of meters away in the other direction. If it had discovered us, it should've turned the other away instead of facing the camera.
You stare at the inhuman creature. Your eyes lock onto one another's.

No matter how small and harmless it looks, this is a creature that broke into the city-state from the Apocalypse of Ashes. Its eyes sparkle, yet no one knows what it sees, what it thinks, and what are the rules of its world...

steps.speaker: Apostle of Ashes
steps.content: Squeak...!

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: Ahhh...!
The creature's body flashes a ray of blue light, and its horns stand on end. The screen trembles. The connection is obviously getting jammed.

This is aggressive behavior. It had realized someone is surveilling it, and is taking on a different form than usual! You quickly pull the camera away. The Apostle raises its front paw and swipes at the camera...
I... found... you...

steps.speaker: Apostle of Ashes
steps.content: ?!! Squeak?!!!
A huge figure suddenly leaps forth, enveloping the startled Apostle like a tiger pounces on a prey, then raises it up.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Are you glowing? Stella, you can glow? Dogs or cats can't do that! How did you do it? Amazing! I'm so lucky to have you as my mascot! My lucky baby!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: I know! You're not from around here, either. You got separated from your family, too! You're a <color=#fb9259>visitor from outer space</color>!!!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: I just got inspired. I know what kind of movie to make! You are my dazzling fantasy!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Let's start working on the script right away!

steps.speaker: Apostle of Ashes
steps.content: ?!! Squeak?? Squeak, squeak!! Squeak...!!
The girl lifts the creature up high in excitement and spins around, leaving your sight with a whoosh. Only the Starbeast's mournful cries remain.

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: Is Stella... crying for help...?
You sigh. The ominous thoughts in your mind subside, but now you're worried about what the Lion Dancing Queen has planned for you tomorrow.
